page.overview:
Who is Areg?

Areg was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Areg was a pyon who served House Harkonnen in Carthag. As he prepared to test a long throw cutteray auger with Dayvan and Ufim, he overheard Davyan say that he had dinner with Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. He was amazed, only for Ufim to point out that Davyan was being sarcastic. Dayvan agreed, but pointed out that they had direct orders from Piter de Vries. Once everything was set up, they activated the cutteray, only for it to go out of phase, vaporize the beam splitter and empty the charge onto Areg. He was literally cooked alive and died screaming.
